title: Validation Result
description: Structured output schema for validation agents. Each criterion reports pass/fail with check-type-specific evidence fields.

status.description: Whether this criterion passed or failed.

evidence.description: Check-type-specific evidence fields. Must contain actual observed values, not generic phrases.

evidence_reject_list.description: Evidence values matching these phrases are rejected as insufficiently specific: 'looks good', 'seems fine', 'appears correct', 'no issues', 'everything works', 'all good', 'working as expected', 'n/a', 'not applicable', 'see above', 'passed', 'ok'.

check_type_evidence_fields.description: Required evidence fields per check type: http=[status_code, url, response_excerpt], http+dom=[status_code, url, dom_selector, element_text], browser+db=[action_performed, sql_query, row_count, sample_row], api+response=[status_code, url, method, response_body_excerpt], process=[process_name, pid_or_status, log_excerpt], screenshot=[screenshot_path, observations], regression=[test_command, exit_code, test_count, failure_count], quality=[commands_run, exit_code, error_count].
